verdict.rationale: Plaid's Balance product is documented as returning real-time balance information, which amounts to on-demand fresh data for balances. Transactions are described as staying current through webhooks rather than through an explicit refresh call. The pack contains no explicit on-demand refresh endpoint and no documentation of refresh semantics. Missing for 10: an explicit API endpoint to trigger a refresh of transactions or other account data, documented refresh semantics (timing, async behavior, completion webhooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
